cover.hook: Anthropic hit $11.5 billion in one quarter — and locked in AI pricing through the fall.
cover.sub: Plus: Ontario sets data centre ground rules, FedNor backs NWO clean energy and Northern Ontario AI security, and wildfire evacuees fall below 900.

reelSub: Anthropic's first profit, Ontario's data centre rules, NWO clean energy, and wildfire recovery — this week in the Northwest.
storySub: Five moves this week that matter for Northern Ontario businesses and operators.

items.title: Anthropic's first profit — and Sonnet 5 pricing locked in
items.body: Anthropic reported preliminary Q2 revenue exceeding $11.5B USD and a first quarterly operating profit of $559M. Separately, Sonnet 5 pricing ($2/$10 per MTok) is now permanent — the September 1 price hike was cancelled.
items.tease: Next: Ontario just set the rules for AI data centres.
items.reelLine: Anthropic hit $11.5B in Q2 revenue and its first profit — and locked Sonnet 5 pricing at $2 per million tokens permanently.

items.title: Ontario launches Data Centre Playbook for AI infrastructure
items.body: On August 13, Ontario released a framework screening data centres on economic, security, and community grounds. Projects over 1MW pay higher power rates. The province says its broader AI strategy could add $122B by 2035.
items.tease: Next: FedNor invests in clean energy on Lake Nipigon.
items.reelLine: Ontario's Data Centre Playbook sets ground rules for AI infrastructure investment — 30-day comment period now open.

items.title: FedNor backs Indigenous biomass heating on Lake Nipigon
items.body: Bingwi Neyaashi Anishinaabek on Lake Nipigon gets $1.1M total through FedNor to build a district biomass heating system using local sawmill wood residue, replacing diesel heat in community buildings.
items.tease: Next: NWO's wildfire recovery in numbers.
items.reelLine: FedNor invests $1.1M in clean energy for a Lake Nipigon First Nation — sawmill waste replaces diesel heat.

items.title: NWO wildfire evacuees down to 829; fire hazard mostly lower
items.body: From 2,800+ at peak to 829 as of August 15 — and active fires in NWO fell from 130 to 87. Fire hazard is mostly low to moderate in the Northwest, with some high hazard in the southwest.
items.tease: Next: FedNor funds AI cybersecurity in Northern Ontario.
items.reelLine: NWO wildfire evacuees fall to 829 — from a peak of 2,800+. 87 active fires remain, mostly low to moderate hazard.

items.title: FedNor funds Northern Ontario AI cybersecurity platform
items.body: SKADI Cyber Defense Corp in North Bay gets $1.2M from FedNor's Regional Defence Investment Initiative to commercialize Frostbow — a cognitive AI platform that detects and responds to cyber threats with minimal human oversight.
items.reelLine: FedNor backs an AI cybersecurity platform in Northern Ontario — $1.2M for SKADI's Frostbow system under the RDII program.

summary.title: AI becomes sustainable, Ontario sets infrastructure rules, and NWO investments continue
summary.body: Anthropic's first quarterly profit and Sonnet 5 pricing permanence reduce uncertainty for businesses building on Claude. Ontario's data centre framework shapes where AI infrastructure lands next. Two FedNor investments — clean energy on Lake Nipigon and AI cybersecurity in North Bay — show the federal agency deploying capital across Northern Ontario's sectors while wildfire recovery continues.

captions.carousel: Anthropic's preliminary Q2 2026 revenue exceeded US$11.5 billion — a roughly 15x year-over-year jump — with its first quarterly operating profit of $559M reported. The same week, Anthropic confirmed Claude Sonnet 5 pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output is now permanent; a September 1 increase will not happen. Ontario released its Data Centre Playbook August 13, opening a 30-day comment period on how the province will screen large AI infrastructure projects — three tests, higher power rates for facilities over 1MW, and closed-loop water system requirements. FedNor invested $1.1M in a biomass clean energy system for Bingwi Neyaashi Anishinaabek on Lake Nipigon, replacing diesel heat with local sawmill wood residue. NWO wildfire evacuees fell from 2,800+ to 829 as of August 15, with active fires down to 87. And FedNor backed SKADI Cyber Defense Corp in North Bay with $1.2M for its Frostbow AI cybersecurity platform.
